source.title: What is the internet? (ladder unit, adapted and machine-drafted)
source.author: Go course authors (drafted by an AI model), adapted from an open-licence text
source.attribution: Adapted from "Dentro de la World Wide Web" by Roopa Pai (illustrations by Delwyn Remedios), Pratham Books / StoryWeaver, via the Global Digital Library, CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Changes: shortened, retold as a conversation between a young woman and her uncle in Honduras, Spain-isms replaced by Honduran words (computadora, celular), the character Nettikutti, the Indian examples and the name of the inventor left out, new passages added; adapted and machine-drafted for the course, not reviewed by a native speaker.
source.provenance: Adapted by an AI model from an openly licensed text (Dentro de la World Wide Web (Roopa Pai; illustrations by Delwyn Remedios), Pratham Books / StoryWeaver, Global Digital Library gdl-1185, CC BY 4.0) for the course; not reviewed by a native speaker. Simplified and rewritten for learners (Spain-isms replaced by Honduran words) and may contain unnatural phrasing. The English lines are the drafter's own.
source.licenseNote: CC BY 4.0; attribution required and changes must be indicated. This unit is an adaptation: the changes are described in "modifications".
source.modifications: Shortened to about 1,300 words; retold as a dialogue (voseo) between a young woman and her uncle in a small Honduran town; Peninsular words replaced (ordenador to computadora, móvil to celular, vosotros forms removed); the character Nettikutti, the Indian examples and the inventor's name omitted; the idea of the web as a network of pages, the email and search examples, the CERN story and the "hip hip hurra" cheer kept in outline; new passages added about a farmer sharing a photograph of a banana harvest and a letter to a brother who has left the country. The English lines are the drafter's own.

review.notes: Machine-drafted by an AI model; awaiting native-speaker review. B1 bridge, unit 08: an ADAPTATION of the open-licence (CC BY 4.0) Global Digital Library text "Dentro de la World Wide Web", as the plan allows (owner decision of 2026-10-06 (1) applies only to Gutenberg texts). The source credit and the list of changes are in the source block. For the Honduran reviewer: (a) computadora and celular replace the Peninsular ordenador and móvil; (b) the dialogue uses voseo between the young woman and her uncle; (c) "jip, jip, hurra" is kept from the source (the lemma pack asks for it): check that it reads naturally for a Honduran reader or replace it with the local cheer; (d) "francés", "madura", "cosecha", "puya", "cáscara" and "envuelto" prepare the next unit, a story about a farmer; (e) the farmer, the buyer and the family are invented.

english.source: drafted with the text; not reviewed

sentences.text: Karla es una muchacha de dieciséis años, y su tío Tomás trabaja en un taller de computadoras, en la esquina del parque.
sentences.english: Karla is a sixteen-year-old girl, and her uncle Tomás works in a computer shop on the corner of the park.

sentences.text: Una tarde, ella llega al taller con una pregunta, y se queda mirando a su tío con una mirada de duda.
sentences.english: One afternoon, she comes to the shop with a question, and she stays looking at her uncle with a look of doubt.

sentences.text: —Tío, todos hablan de internet, pero yo no sé qué es.
sentences.english: "Uncle, everybody talks about the internet, but I do not know what it is."

sentences.text: —¿Ni siquiera vos, que tenés celular? —le dice él, sonriendo.
sentences.english: "Not even you, who have a cell phone?" he says, smiling.

sentences.text: —Lo uso, pero no lo entiendo.
sentences.english: "I use it, but I do not understand it.

sentences.text: Es como manejar un carro sin saber qué hay debajo.
sentences.english: It is like driving a car without knowing what is underneath."

sentences.text: Tomás la mira con una mirada tranquila, todavía sonriendo.
sentences.english: Tomás looks at her with a calm look, still smiling.

sentences.text: La muchacha se sienta delante de él, con calma.
sentences.english: The girl sits in front of him, calmly.

sentences.text: —Es una buena pregunta —dice—.
sentences.english: "It is a good question," he says.

sentences.text: Sentate, y te lo explico.
sentences.english: "Sit down, and I will explain it to you."

sentences.text: —Internet es una red muy grande de computadoras —empieza el tío—.
sentences.english: "The internet is a very large network of computers," the uncle begins.

sentences.text: Millones de ellas, conectados entre sí en todo el mundo.
sentences.english: "Millions of them, connected to each other all over the world."

sentences.text: —¿Sólo ellas? —pregunta Karla.
sentences.english: "Only them?" Karla asks.

sentences.text: —No sólo.
sentences.english: "Not only.

sentences.text: Incluso un celular como el tuyo es una computadora pequeña, y está con todas las otras.
sentences.english: Even a cell phone like yours is a small computer, and it is with all the others."

sentences.text: —Pero no veo nada entre ellas.
sentences.english: "But I see nothing between them.

sentences.text: Dicen que estamos conectados, ¿pero cómo?
sentences.english: They say we are connected, but how?"

sentences.text: —Algunas van por debajo de la tierra, incluso por el fondo del mar, y otras no necesitan nada.
sentences.english: "Some go under the ground, even through the bottom of the sea, and others need nothing.

sentences.text: Por eso podés caminar por la calle y seguir conectada.
sentences.english: That is why you can walk down the street and stay connected."

sentences.text: —Es una realidad que no entiendo bien —dice ella—.
sentences.english: "It is a reality I do not understand well," she says.

sentences.text: Es una realidad muy grande.
sentences.english: "It is a very big reality.

sentences.text: ¿Quién es el dueño de todo eso?
sentences.english: Who owns all that?"

sentences.text: —Nadie es el único dueño, y ese es el efecto más bonito.
sentences.english: "Nobody is the only owner, and that is the nicest effect.

sentences.text: Es una red libre, y cualquiera puede usarla.
sentences.english: It is a free network, and anyone can use it."

sentences.text: Karla se queda callada, con la mano en la frente, frente a la mesa vacía.
sentences.english: Karla stays quiet, with her hand on her forehead, in front of the empty table.

sentences.text: Es un pensamiento nuevo para ella: algo tan grande, sin un solo dueño.
sentences.english: It is a new thought for her: something so big, without a single owner.

sentences.text: —Libre, sin un jefe, y con un solo efecto: todos podemos hablar.
sentences.english: "Free, without a boss, and with a single effect: all of us can talk."

sentences.text: —Pero la web no es internet —dice Tomás.
sentences.english: "But the web is not the internet," says Tomás.

sentences.text: —¿No?
sentences.english: "No?"

sentences.text: —Karla levanta la frente—.
sentences.english: Karla raises her brow.

sentences.text: ¿Y entonces qué es?
sentences.english: "Then what is it?"

sentences.text: —Internet es la red, y la web es lo que hay en ella: una colección muy grande de páginas.
sentences.english: "The internet is the network, and the web is what is in it: a very large collection of pages.

sentences.text: Hoy hay millones y millones.
sentences.english: Today there are millions and millions."

sentences.text: —¿Y qué es una página?
sentences.english: "And what is a page?"

sentences.text: —Es como un papel, pero con información: palabras, números, una imagen, una canción, una película.
sentences.english: "It is like a paper, but with information: words, numbers, an image, a song, a film."

sentences.text: —¿Y por qué se llama web?
sentences.english: "And why is it called web?"

sentences.text: —Porque cada una va con otras, y esa palabra quiere decir red.
sentences.english: "Because each one goes with others, and that word means network."

sentences.text: —Pensalo varias veces, hasta que sea normal —dice Tomás—.
sentences.english: "Think about it several times, until it is normal," says Tomás.

sentences.text: Yo lo pensé varias horas.
sentences.english: "I thought about it for several hours."

sentences.text: —¿Y cómo llego a la página que quiero, entre tantas?
sentences.english: "And how do I get to the page I want, among so many?"

sentences.text: —Cada una tiene una dirección, igual que tu casa.
sentences.english: "Each one has an address, just like your house.

sentences.text: Si conocés la dirección, vas ahí.
sentences.english: If you know the address, you go there.

sentences.text: Y si no, se lo preguntás a ella, y te ayuda a buscar.
sentences.english: And if not, you ask it, and it helps you search."

sentences.text: —¡Qué genial! —dice Karla—.
sentences.english: "How great!" says Karla.

sentences.text: Es como preguntarle a alguien que lo sabe todo.
sentences.english: "It is like asking someone who knows everything."

sentences.text: Ante esa idea, Tomás ríe.
sentences.english: Faced with that idea, Tomás laughs.

sentences.text: —Casi.
sentences.english: "Almost.

sentences.text: Pero también hay mentiras, y por eso, ante todo, uno tiene que pensar antes de creer.
sentences.english: But there are also lies, and that is why, above all, one has to think before believing.

sentences.text: Eso no es nada genial.
sentences.english: That is not great at all."

sentences.text: —¿Y cuánto cuesta todo eso? —pregunta Karla.
sentences.english: "And how much does all that cost?" Karla asks.

sentences.text: —Cada mes hay que pagar por eso, pero lo que compartís no cuesta nada.
sentences.english: "Every month you have to pay for that, but what you share costs nothing.

sentences.text: Para muchos, eso ya es mucho.
sentences.english: For many people, that is already a lot."

sentences.text: —Mirá este caso —sigue el tío—.
sentences.english: "Look at this case," the uncle goes on.

sentences.text: Don Mario es campesino, y tiene una finca de plátanos.
sentences.english: "Don Mario is a farmer, and he has a banana farm.

sentences.text: La cosecha de este año fue muy buena, y todo el plátano está maduro.
sentences.english: This year's harvest was very good, and all the plantain is ripe."

sentences.text: —¿Y qué hace con eso?
sentences.english: "And what does he do with that?"

sentences.text: —Ayer sacó una imagen de su cosecha con el celular, y la compartió.
sentences.english: "Yesterday he took a picture of his harvest with his cell phone, and shared it.

sentences.text: Se ve el plátano en su cáscara color sol, y alguno con una puya negra en la punta.
sentences.english: You can see the plantain in its sun-colored peel, and one with a black thorn at the tip.

sentences.text: Una puya cuesta dinero, y la puya se corta antes de enviar la imagen.
sentences.english: A thorn costs money, and the thorn is cut off before the image is sent."

sentences.text: —Don Mario no sabía ni siquiera escribir un correo, ni siquiera un mensaje.
sentences.english: "Don Mario did not even know how to write an email, not even a message.

sentences.text: Su hija le enseñó, y ahora él pone cada foto con su dirección.
sentences.english: His daughter taught him, and now he puts each photo with its address."

sentences.text: —¿Y quién ve esa colección de fotos?
sentences.english: "And who sees that collection of photos?"

sentences.text: —Cualquier persona, en cualquier lugar.
sentences.english: "Any person, anywhere.

sentences.text: Un señor de Francia ve que los plátanos están dulces, que el plátano está maduro, y manda un correo en francés para preguntar el precio.
sentences.english: A man from France sees that the plantains are sweet, that the plantain is ripe, and sends an email in French to ask the price."

sentences.text: —Pero don Mario no habla francés.
sentences.english: "But don Mario does not speak French."

sentences.text: —Su hija sí habla francés, y la colección de fotos hace lo demás.
sentences.english: "His daughter speaks French, and the collection of photos does the rest.

sentences.text: También mandó unos dulces, en un paquete.
sentences.english: He also sent some sweets, in a package."

sentences.text: —¿Y llega el mismo día?
sentences.english: "And it arrives the same day?"

sentences.text: —En menos de un minuto, y no cuesta nada.
sentences.english: "In less than a minute, and it costs nothing.

sentences.text: Antes, una carta de papel tardaba semanas.
sentences.english: Before, a paper letter took weeks.

sentences.text: Y un paquete envuelto tardaba más.
sentences.english: And a wrapped package took longer."

sentences.text: —¿Y los plátanos también viajan así?
sentences.english: "And do the plantains also travel like that?"

sentences.text: —No —ríe Tomás—.
sentences.english: "No," Tomás laughs.

sentences.text: Sólo la información.
sentences.english: "Only the information.

sentences.text: Los plátanos dulces van en un paquete, envuelto en papel, por el camino.
sentences.english: The sweet plantains go in a package, wrapped in paper, along the road."

sentences.text: —Conque una imagen vende una cosecha —dice Karla—.
sentences.english: "So an image sells a harvest," says Karla.

sentences.text: Conque así empieza todo.
sentences.english: "So that is how everything starts."

sentences.text: —Así empieza.
sentences.english: "That is how it starts.

sentences.text: En una ocasión, don Mario vendió todo en un día.
sentences.english: On one occasion, don Mario sold everything in a day.

sentences.text: En otra ocasión, ganó más que en el año.
sentences.english: On another occasion, he earned more than in the whole year.

sentences.text: Para él, es puro gusto.
sentences.english: For him, it is pure pleasure."

sentences.text: —Conque ya lo sabés —dice Tomás, y toca la mesa con la punta del dedo—.
sentences.english: "So now you know," says Tomás, and touches the table with the tip of his finger.

sentences.text: La web también sirve para trabajar.
sentences.english: "The web is also good for working."

sentences.text: —Pero hay peligros, ¿verdad? —dice ella.
sentences.english: "But there are dangers, right?" she says.

sentences.text: —Sí.
sentences.english: "Yes.

sentences.text: Cualquiera puede escribir cualquier cosa, y no todo es verdad.
sentences.english: Anyone can write anything, and not everything is true.

sentences.text: Una página puede mentir.
sentences.english: A page can lie.

sentences.text: Ese es el único problema.
sentences.english: That is the only problem."

sentences.text: —¿Y cómo sé qué es verdad?
sentences.english: "And how do I know what is true?"

sentences.text: —Preguntá a una persona que sepa, y leé varias páginas.
sentences.english: "Ask a person who knows, and read several pages.

sentences.text: Un buen pensamiento vale más que cien fotos.
sentences.english: A good thought is worth more than a hundred photos."

sentences.text: —También hay que cuidar la información propia —dice Tomás—.
sentences.english: "You also have to take care of your own information," says Tomás.

sentences.text: Tu nombre, tu casa, tus cosas.
sentences.english: "Your name, your house, your things."

sentences.text: —Eso lo sé: no se la doy a cualquiera.
sentences.english: "That I know: I do not give it to just anyone."

sentences.text: —Muy bien.
sentences.english: "Very good.

sentences.text: Así todo es más libre, pero tu información no tiene que serlo.
sentences.english: That way everything is freer, but your information does not have to be.

sentences.text: Es lo único que no se comparte.
sentences.english: It is the only thing you do not share."

sentences.text: —¿Y quién tuvo la idea de todo esto? —pregunta la muchacha.
sentences.english: "And who had the idea for all this?" the girl asks.

sentences.text: —Un hombre que trabajaba en el CERN, un gran centro de Suiza.
sentences.english: "A man who worked at CERN, a large center in Switzerland.

sentences.text: Allí muchos trabajaban juntos, pero no podían compartir su trabajo rápido.
sentences.english: Many people worked together there, but they could not share their work quickly.

sentences.text: Muchas veces tenían que viajar.
sentences.english: Many times they had to travel."

sentences.text: —Y mandar cartas de papel —dice ella.
sentences.english: "And send paper letters," she says.

sentences.text: —Eso.
sentences.english: "Exactly.

sentences.text: Entonces él pensó en una manera de poner todo lo que sabían en una sola red.
sentences.english: Then he thought of a way to put everything they knew into a single network.

sentences.text: Fue un efecto muy grande: todos podían leer lo mismo, a la vez.
sentences.english: It was a very big effect: everybody could read the same thing at once."

sentences.text: —¿Y la idea fue buena?
sentences.english: "And was the idea good?"

sentences.text: —Muy buena.
sentences.english: "Very good.

sentences.text: Y en una ocasión, ante todos, dijo que la idea no era sólo del CERN.
sentences.english: And on one occasion, before everybody, he said the idea was not only CERN's.

sentences.text: La dio a todos, sin pedir dinero.
sentences.english: He gave it to everyone, without asking for money.

sentences.text: Incluso los que no tenían nada pudieron usarla.
sentences.english: Even those who had nothing could use it."

sentences.text: —¡Qué idea tan buena! —dice Karla—.
sentences.english: "What a good idea!" says Karla.

sentences.text: Ese hombre tenía un pensamiento muy grande.
sentences.english: "That man had a very big thought."

sentences.text: —Por eso hoy millones de personas usan la web.
sentences.english: "That is why millions of people use the web today.

sentences.text: Si hubiera dicho que no, todo sería diferente.
sentences.english: If he had said no, everything would be different."

sentences.text: —Entonces merece un buen jip —dice Karla.
sentences.english: "Then he deserves a good hip," says Karla.

sentences.text: —¡Jip, jip, hurra! —gritan los dos, y se ríen.
sentences.english: "Hip, hip, hooray!" they both shout, and laugh.

sentences.text: Es una idea genial, piensan, y una realidad más bonita que un cuento.
sentences.english: It is a great idea, they think, and a reality prettier than a tale.

sentences.text: Esa noche, Karla se sienta delante de la computadora de su casa, y le tiembla la mano.
sentences.english: That night, Karla sits in front of the computer at her house, and her hand trembles.

sentences.text: Una finca madura, un plátano maduro, un señor de Francia: todo eso cabe en un celular.
sentences.english: A ripe farm, a ripe plantain, a man from France: all of that fits in a cell phone.

sentences.text: Su hermano mayor se fue hace dos años a otro país, y ella nunca le escribió.
sentences.english: Her older brother went away two years ago to another country, and she never wrote to him.

sentences.text: Siempre pensaba: «¿Qué le voy a decir?».
sentences.english: She always thought: "What am I going to tell him?"

sentences.text: Pero ahora no tiene miedo, y escribe: «Hola, hermano.
sentences.english: But now she is not afraid, and she writes: "Hello, brother.

sentences.text: Hoy aprendí qué es eso.»
sentences.english: Today I learned what that is."

sentences.text: Piensa en la mirada de su hermano en el aeropuerto, y la mano le temblaba tanto que casi no podía escribir.
sentences.english: She thinks of her brother's look at the airport, and her hand trembled so much that she could hardly write.

sentences.text: Agrega una frase sobre la novela que está leyendo, porque a él siempre le gustaban las novelas.
sentences.english: She adds a sentence about the novel she is reading, because he always liked novels.

sentences.text: Y sigue con otra novela, la que él dejó a medias antes de marcharse.
sentences.english: And she goes on with another novel, the one he left half-read before leaving.

sentences.text: Cuando termina, el mensaje se va, y ella se queda un rato sonriendo, con los ojos llenos de agua.
sentences.english: When she finishes, the message goes, and she stays a while smiling, with her eyes full of water.

sentences.text: Ella tampoco quería marcharse de la silla: no quería marcharse hasta recibir una respuesta.
sentences.english: She did not want to leave the chair either: she did not want to leave until she received an answer.

sentences.text: En menos de un minuto llega la respuesta: «Qué bueno, Karla.
sentences.english: In less than a minute the answer arrives: "How good, Karla.

sentences.text: ¿Ya sabés que me alegraste el día?»
sentences.english: Do you know you made my day?"

sentences.text: La mano todavía le temblaba, pero ahora de alegría, y Karla pensó que todo eso era puro milagro.
sentences.english: Her hand was still trembling, but now with joy, and Karla thought that all of that was pure miracle.

sentences.text: Y era puro gusto también.
sentences.english: And it was pure pleasure too.
